plugin.name: SquareSoft_Core_Triggers
plugin.author: OpenAI
plugin.purpose: Portable SquareSoft status colouring and cooldown notices
plugin.description:
SQUARESOFT CORE TRIGGERS v1.1
Portable replacements for SquareSoft triggers that previously lived in the MUSHclient world file.
Included: * HP current-value green -> red gradient on the <<HP: ... MP: ...>> line * MP current/max cyan -> light-purple -> red gradient * OVERALL CONDITION HP/SP percentage gradients * red "Mob", light-green "Exp", fixed green << and >> * six-line magenta "You can use chakra again." ready notice
Commands: ss core status ss core on|off ss core notices on|off
All trigger names are stable and live in group SS_CORE.

muclient.script:
CORE_TRIGGER_GROUP = "SS_CORE" local coreEnabled = GetVariable("core_enabled") ~= "false" local chakraNoticesEnabled = GetVariable("chakra_notices_enabled") ~= "false"
local function Clamp(value, low, high) value = tonumber(value) or low if value < low then return low end if value > high then return high end return value end
local function Round(value) return math.floor((tonumber(value) or 0) + 0.5) end
local function RGBName(r, g, b) r = Clamp(Round(r), 0, 255) g = Clamp(Round(g), 0, 255) b = Clamp(Round(b), 0, 255) -- MUSHclient colour integers use Windows COLORREF order: rr + gg*256 + bb*65536. return RGBColourToName(r + g * 256 + b * 65536) end
local function Lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
local function HPGradient(percent) local t = Clamp(percent, 0, 100) / 100 return RGBName(255 * (1 - t), 255 * t, 0) end
local function MPGradient(percent) local p = Clamp(percent, 0, 100)
-- 0% red -> 50% light purple -> 100% cyan. local r, g, b if p <= 50 then local t = p / 50 r = Lerp(255, 200, t) g = Lerp(0, 135, t) b = Lerp(0, 255, t) else local t = (p - 50) / 50 r = Lerp(200, 0, t) g = Lerp(135, 255, t) b = Lerp(255, 255, t) end
return RGBName(r, g, b) end
local function SafePercent(current, maximum) current = tonumber(current) or 0 maximum = tonumber(maximum) or 0 if maximum <= 0 then return 0 end return Clamp((current / maximum) * 100, 0, 100) end
function ColourStats(name, line, wildcards) local hpColour = HPGradient(SafePercent(wildcards[3], wildcards[5])) local mpColour = MPGradient(SafePercent(wildcards[7], wildcards[9]))
ColourTell("green", "", wildcards[1] or "<<") Tell(wildcards[2] or "HP: ") ColourTell(hpColour, "", wildcards[3] or "") Tell((wildcards[4] or "/") .. (wildcards[5] or "") .. (wildcards[6] or " MP: ")) ColourTell(mpColour, "", wildcards[7] or "") Tell(wildcards[8] or "/") ColourTell(mpColour, "", wildcards[9] or "") ColourTell("green", "", wildcards[10] or ">>") Note("") end
function ColourCondition(name, line, wildcards) local hpColour = HPGradient(tonumber(wildcards[3]) or 0) local spColour = MPGradient(tonumber(wildcards[5]) or 0)
ColourTell("green", "", wildcards[1] or "<<") Tell(wildcards[2] or "OVERALL CONDITION:<HP:") ColourTell(hpColour, "", wildcards[3] or "") Tell(wildcards[4] or "%> <SP:") ColourTell(spColour, "", wildcards[5] or "") Tell(wildcards[6] or "%> <") ColourTell("red", "", wildcards[7] or "Mob") Tell(wildcards[8] or ": None> ") ColourTell("lightgreen", "", wildcards[9] or "Exp") Tell(wildcards[10] or ":0%") ColourTell("green", "", wildcards[11] or ">>") Note("") end
function ChakraReadyNotice(name, line, wildcards) if not chakraNoticesEnabled then -- This trigger omits the server line so the portable colourized form owns -- the display. When notices are disabled, reproduce one normal line. Note(line or "You can use chakra again.") return end
for i = 1, 6 do ColourNote("magenta", "", line or "You can use chakra again.") end end
local function SetCoreEnabled(enabled) coreEnabled = enabled and true or false SetVariable("core_enabled", coreEnabled and "true" or "false") EnableGroup(CORE_TRIGGER_GROUP, coreEnabled) end
-- Public API used by the suite installer during v1.x -> v2.0 migration. function SetPortableEnabled(value) local enabled = (value == true) or tostring(value or ""):lower() == "true" or tostring(value or "") == "1" SetCoreEnabled(enabled) return coreEnabled and "true" or "false" end
function CoreEnableAlias(name, line, wildcards) SetCoreEnabled(tostring(wildcards[1] or ""):lower() == "on") ColourNote(coreEnabled and "lime" or "yellow", "", "[SquareSoft Core] " .. (coreEnabled and "enabled." or "disabled.")) end
function CoreStatusAlias(name, line, wildcards) ColourNote(coreEnabled and "lime" or "yellow", "", "[SquareSoft Core] Portable core triggers are " .. (coreEnabled and "ON." or "OFF.")) ColourNote("gray", "", " Chakra ready notice: " .. (chakraNoticesEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")) end
function CoreNoticesAlias(name, line, wildcards) chakraNoticesEnabled = tostring(wildcards[1] or ""):lower() == "on" SetVariable("chakra_notices_enabled", chakraNoticesEnabled and "true" or "false") ColourNote("lime", "", "[SquareSoft Core] Chakra ready notice " .. (chakraNoticesEnabled and "enabled." or "disabled.")) end
function OnPluginInstall() EnableGroup(CORE_TRIGGER_GROUP, coreEnabled) end
function OnPluginEnable() EnableGroup(CORE_TRIGGER_GROUP, coreEnabled) end
